name: Aetherfall
subtitle: Pixel fantasy action MMORPG
description:
When the star core fell, the world broke into countless floating lands. Take up your sword and set out across the Breeze Plains.

Aetherfall is an original top-down 2D pixel-art online role-playing game. Adventure alongside other players in one shared world.

• Action combat that hits: movement, dodges and skill combos are all in your hands, and every hit and knockback is decided fairly by the server.
• AUTO when you want a break: turn on AUTO while online. Offline rewards build up for at most 8 hours and never advance quests or bosses.
• Six first jobs: start as the front-line Bladebound, with the Arcanist, Windstrider, Shade Walker, Luminary and Machinist on the way.
• Take on the Corrupted Heartwood dungeon: solve its light mirrors and defeat the boss within.
• Fair free-to-play: no power for sale. Everything you can pay for is cosmetic, so how strong you are depends on how you play.
• Landscape fullscreen with controls made for touch.

Create an account with Google, GitHub, Facebook, LINE or your email address. One account works on every platform.

The game is still in development; graphics and content keep improving.
promotionalText: An original pixel-art MMORPG with hands-on action combat, and AUTO when you need a break.
